description.text:
Terastal Gathering (太晶盛聚) was a Scarlet & Violet booster in Simplified Chinese, on sale from 12 June 2026 in 10-card packs holding three or four holos. Eevee and its evolutions, Terastallized to the Stellar type, are on its cover, and it has nine Stellar Tera cards of them, from Eevee ex to Sylveon ex. It gathers strong cards that had already made their mark, such as Iron Hands ex, Dragapult ex and Terapagos ex, some in new art like Roaring Moon ex, Raging Bolt ex and Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex, along with handy Trainers and new and returning ACE SPEC cards. Its many Special Art Rares, of Pokémon ex and Supporters, include a second one for Sylveon ex, and some Poké Ball and Master Ball pattern holos come in a special finish.

Many boxes came out with it the same day, most in nine versions, one for Eevee and each evolution: coin sets with one pack, a holo of that Pokémon and a coin; collection boxes with two packs, a damage-counter case and a metal magnet; badge sets with one pack and one of 81 badges; quicksand card display pendant boxes with two packs and a holo of the pendant's Pokémon, a Poké Ball pattern holo or, with the rarer Terastallized pendants, its Pokémon ex; and gift sets with eight packs, a binder and sleeves. An Eevee family premium box held 15 packs, Espeon ex and Umbreon ex holos, a playmat and other battle accessories. Its main cards are numbered out of 208; full-art, Special Art Rare and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 259.
